description: Get each ticker's newest traded, settled daily close in USD, with one-session change, volume, and trailing 52-week closing range. Rows can have different dates while a session settles; use the Date column. Change is omitted when the immediately prior trading session is absent. Split-limited or partial 52-week ranges are marked in the response. This is settled history, not an intraday quote.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25). Class shares may use BRK-B or BRK.B.
